key_burial.name: Glasshouse Key
key_burial.description: Opens the glasshouse. Kept on a hook by the beds. The gardener locked up every night and nobody could say who for.

key_stone.name: The Chairman's Key
key_stone.description: Opens the stair under the Hoar Stone. Stamped G.M.Co. The tag is in the foreman's hand: THE HOAR STONE, ON THE GRAVEYARD FOOTPATH. THE CHAIRMAN'S. HIS, NOT OURS.

the_ball.name: The Ball
the_ball.description: The county's gold, cast into one sphere the size of a fist. It's warm, and it was in his hands. It's heavier every time I pick it up.
